releases.notes:
Hello, I managed to drop this small version through all the academic works and projects.

## Active Skill [Pounce]
- Added mechanics to catch mouse on Snow Blocks

## Active Skill [Foxify]
- Fixed Fear bossbar Toggle Translation not translated in Mandarin
- Added reasons for unable to foxify, (either Foxtype or admin setting)
- Revamped code logic, theoratically more rigid

## Passive Skill [Foxiality]
- No longer trying to tame foxes with NoAI
- Removed fox kill penalties

## Passive Skill [Timidity]
- Fixed Fear bossbar not being removed if you change origin while it is visible
- Added a hint about using [Sneak] to highlight nearby fear source, when first time getting Fear effect

## Advancements
**2 New Advancements**
1. One Happy Foxie: Received all 6 interactions
2. Snacks Squeaking in the Snow: Catch a mouse use Active Skill [Pounce]

# Other
Added support for Origins-Legacy, tested with latest version on 26.3 `Origins-Legacy-1.12.20+26.3.jar`.

Note: This version is seldomly tested. Most discrepancies happens with Vanilla Minecraft's own change, and lack of Pehkui in higher version.

The same version might be usable in other versions where Origins-legacy is being used. You can install it as datapack + resource pack to try it out.

releases.notes:
Done with my 20-weeks Professional Internship.\
Here is an update with tons of new QOL stuffs and fixes :3

## Active Skill [Foxify]

1. New option in the [Fox Setting Book] to allow you to ride any entities instead of the few limited mob types (Suggested By Un7x)
2. Probably fixed a bug causing incorrect hitbox height when dismounting from a player (Found by RangerRoseBerry)
3. Tag `foxie_trust` now won't be revoked by damage. Instead, the fox player needs to [Sneak] + [Save Toolbar Activator] on a trusted player to revoke the trust

## Passive Skill [Timidity]

1. Fear Timer will be displayed as a Bossbar when Fear effect is present. This bossbar can be hidden with `/trigger foxtype add 70`
2. All fear conquer progress is tracked using `scoreboard` instead
3. Probably prevent a thunder that's too far to be heard from scaring you
4. Removed the `elytra` check for Fear of the Nether, and `conquer fear of death` no longer mute `fear of dimensions`
5. Triggering a `Totem of Undying` can now counts towards conquering `Fear of Death`

## Passive Skill [Fluffy]

1. Freeze Immunity when not in rain => Freeze Immunity when fur is not wet
2. With Reference to the 5 minutes `unflammability` meter.
    > In previous version, this meter only means "Time since fur wet".\
    > And will light you on fire when taking fire/hot-floor damage if it's past 5 minutes since fur is wet.\
    > Now, when the meter is within 2.5 minutes:
    >
    > 1. Fire damage received reduced by 75%
    > 2. Extinguish fire on you
    > 3. Forward the timer by 10s

## Passive Skill [Foxiality]

1. You can now not sleep when _12_ blocks around an `armor stand`
2. `Grabby Paws` subpower used to "Pull items in 2 blocks towards you". Now it's a true `Pick Up Range Boost` via `additionalEntityAttributes:player.collection_range`. The original effect is retained for Forge and 1.21.1.
3. Upon killing entities with melee, all the entity's drops will now be teleport to you instantly

## Passive Skill [Weak]

Having `Conduit Power` and `Water Breathing` will no longer deplete your air

## Hidden Skill [Fox Sound Pack]

1. The "Wholesome Interaction!" message will be sent to any entities without `foxie_trust` tag, and grant them `foxie_trust`
2. Fixed the belly rub tellraw not colored
3. Added Brush Fur Interaction:
    > Triggered when interactor is holding a brush
    > Play brushing sound that ignores interaction CD while constrainted by an extent to avoid spamming, but quite randomly although not intended
    > 10% Chance to drop a string (Fox Fur :3), then won't drop another string in 30s

## Optional Skill [Leash]

Power Revamped

1. Allow a leasher to leash multiple entities, instead of restricted to 1
2. The Leash anchor will start riding leasher on spawned
3. Fixed other players are able to interact with a leashable player even if they do not have a leash in hand
4. Improved the translation of Extended Leash tip

## Non-player Skill [SleepinFox]

Might've fixed a bug that the disguise sleeping fox being hurt by predators doesn't return damage to you

## Advancements

1. Added most of the conquerable fear as Advancements, and able to see the progress in advancement tab
2. Added 2 new advancements: `berry_damage` and `damp_fur_insulator`, `use_mace` for 1.21.1 [Suggested by Kln]
3. Removed useless `sends_telemetry_event` from all advancements
4. Advancement `Crits from Heaven` no longer counts damage to Ghast (Since deflected fireball can easily deal >100 damage to ghast)
5. Advancement `Brave Litol Fox` will now require `Fear of Death` to be conquered

---

1.19-1.19.3 version will no longer be supported (considering it's the one with the least downloads...)

Spent my whole recess week on this, I have 6 Assignments due tmr, this is fine
---
**General QOL Changes:**
1. Re-introduced a better [Fox Settings] Book filled with more buttons and more unnecessary stuffs
2. Integrated the 2 Figura Functions and Refresh settings function into the book, and removed from /function commands
3. Further optimized performance
4. Kills with extra strike will correctly count towards your kill and display correct death message

**Active Skill [Pounce]**
**Changed Content**
Added support for "Damage Muffler"

**Active Skill [Hunt]**
**Fixed Bug**
You can no longer trigger flash by spamming shift after triggering magnetoreception pounce
**Changed Content**
1. Added support for "Damage Muffler"
2. Extra Strike will now be affected by your Foodlevel-based damage modifier

**Active Skill [Foxify]**
Removed a really cool mechanics that didn't work before, spent hours fixed and ultimately found out it cannot be used in Forge Origins :(

**Passive Skill [Fluffy]**
**Fixed Bug**
Fixed in rare occasions, shake water / snow is not triggered

**Passive Skill [Foxiality]**
**Changed Content**
Fox near you will not shake head

**Passive Skill [Unique Taste]**
**QOL Change:**
The power now works with the item tag system, meaning that:
1. The modded foods are no longer affected
2. You can add in / remove foods from the tag file to your needs (Even include foods from installed food mods if you want)
**Changed Contents:**
1. Buffed foods will no longer be always edible 
2. Added milk and honey into the food list that give you regen
3. Nerfed Berries a bit more
4. Refill your hunger if you are in Creative mode

**Hidden Skill [Fox Sound Pack]**
**Fixed Bug:**
Fixed interactions(Boop/Pet/Feed) Messages not being translated
**Changed Content:**
It is now using the same food tags as the Passive Skill [Unique Taste]

**Hidden Skill [Universal Setting]**
Added a new setting: "Damage Muffler"
It's a new damage bonus system if you want a serious nerf of damage output.

**Hidden Skill [Ticks]**
Removed. Reverted to legacy coding standards.


For 1.21: Fixed Mace Nerf condition
Integrated into Origins.Alpha.9


Fox Player Model:
Added detection for Kitsune / Ninetails Pounce

---
**This Version Can be used for expanded fox V3.0.0**

releases.notes:
This version took me way to long to develop.
The main focus is to optimize performance as much as possible, without sacrificing current mechanics.
Might not have time to do the fox evolution or next version in a few months. (Unless of course, serious bugs occur)
Also for this version, Forge is almost as functional as Fabric. I resolved those major differences like "Unable to yoink fox / no Death sound played". Right now only minor differences exist.

---

**General QOL Changes**
1. Refactored nearly all the code to be as performant as possible, sacrificing all the remaining readability.
Tons of restructuring took place. Do expect stuffs work differently than before, or even different than what the wiki suggests
2. Removed Fox-setting book.
3. Implemented an all-in-one file containing all the default settings, that allow server owner to change easily for everyone. For detailed instructions, refers to the "For Server Admin" file in side .zip file.

**Active Skill [Pounce]**
**Aesthetic Change:**
Slightly adjusted screen overlay

**Active Skill [Hunt]**
**QOL Changes:**
Manually translated the keybind of the GUI tooltip. This will fix info on the Origin Gui in Forge.
**Content Changes:**
1. Invisible can no longer hide your glowing effect (Nerf)
2. You can no longer sense unliving entities (Nerf) (Somehow Armor stands are alive)
3. You will instantly reset Prepare stage if you take any damage during it (Nerf)
4. Your prepare stage will take longer if you move (Nerf)
5. Hunt will be extended if you pounce at last second, until you land (Buff)
6. Entering Hunt will immediately remove fear effect, due to the Timidity Power being reworked to be less janky (Unexpected Buff)
7. Hunt can now work in modded dimensions? (Untested)
**Aesthetic Changes:**
1. Slightly adjusted screen overlay
2. Slightly adjusted invis timeframe, your cape will disappear almost the same frame as you

**Active Skill [Foxify]**
**Fixed Bugs:**
1. Fixed fox pups foxify cannot invis / shake (TIL: AOT Setting Age will nullify the AOT power it has)
2. Fixed Forge cannot yoink Fox like in Fabric
**Content Changes:**
1. Redesigned the triggering of almost all the functions
2. Shifted the Fox Force Sit and Fox Get Item power from **Passive Skill [Foxiality]** to here
3. You can now actively enter [Sleepin Mode] while riding something
4. You can now change your [Sleepin Mode] Fox to sit
5. You can now instantly ride a player, removed the charge up
6. You can now ride not only player, but also armor stand, bee, slime, axolotl. Basically any entity listed inside \data\thorigins\tags\entity_types\ridable.json. Add more into it if you want
7. Adjusted your hitbox and eye height, now you likely won't block their view when riding players. But these two scales will be constantly resetted now.
8. You can enter [Sleepin Mode] when riding stuffs, and you can stay being a fox even if the stuffs move.
9. Implemented a cheap way of detecting your perspective. So that hat fox automatically stopped rendering itself when you are riding.

**Passive Skill [Foxiality]**
**Content Changes:**
1. Shifted the two Fox interactions into Active Skill [Foxify]
2. Polar Bear and Wolves do 2x damage to you (Nerf)

**Passive Skill [Fluffy]**
**Content Changes:**
1. Removed evaporation mechanics (Add lots load while the effects are trivial in game)
2. Received Fire Damage increases form x 1.5 to x1.75 (Nerf)
3. Received Explosion Damage increases from x1 to x1.75 (Nerf)

**Passive Skill [Timidity]**
**Content Changes:**
Besides adaptations, dying 8 times ignores dimensions fear (Small Buff) (What's worse than dying anyways)
**Aesthetic Change:**
1. Removed blood trail (Purely unnecessary aesthetic stuff that is actually really unaesthetic)
2. Added instructions to conquer fears

**Passive Skill [Unique Taste]**
**Content Changes:**
Halved the saturation buff on berries (Nerf)

**Hidden Skill [Fox Sound Pack]**
**Fixed Bug:**

...
